notablePrerequisites: Tarrian's Soulcleaver attached to Evolution Witness.
description:
Cast Urza's Bauble by paying {0}.
Activate Urza's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Tarrian's Soulcleaver triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Urza's Bauble from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Urza's Bauble ability, causing you to look at a card in a player's hand, and causing you to draw a card at the beginning of the next upkeep step.
Repeat.
